title: Ethical Concerns of Generative AI and Mitigation Strategies: A Systematic Mapping Study

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic mapping study and thematic analysis of primary literature, highlighting cases where AI models perpetuate social stereotypes (e.g., analyzing historical resume data that resulted in lower ratings for women).

Systematic mapping study reviewing primary literature, including evaluating studies that used fill-in-the-blank methods in GPT-2 models to observe probabilities assigned to masked binary racial references ("White" and "Black").
Thematic analysis of literature identifying biases caused by time-based limitations and temporal cutoffs in training data, which leads to outdated or historically skewed AI-generated content.

Systematic mapping study extracting ethical concerns regarding AI systems that overlook the needs of individuals with disabilities due to inadequate or absent accessibility features (e.g., screen readers, alternative text).
Systematic mapping study identifying limitations in AI language translation capabilities and system designs that exclude non-native speakers or individuals from diverse linguistic backgrounds.
